notes.title: Public TestFire Out Now!
notes.notes:
Embark on an epic journey as we proudly present the first Public TestFire of our upcoming game, Frontier!

TestFire 1 Highlights:

🌟 Contest of the Frontier:

Invite your friends to partake in the ultimate contest. Will you climb to the top or embrace the excitement below?
This is a multiplayer game after all, playing this alone is possible but a questionable decision.


🎮 Variety of MiniGames:

[olist]
[*] Level Editor: Unleash your creativity! Build and share your custom levels on the Steam Workshop.
[*] Bomb It: Classic explosive mayhem awaits. Challenge your friends and see who comes out on top!
[*] Spleef: Watch the ground crumble beneath your feet. Can you stay on top until the end?
[*] Jump Duck: The name says it all. Don't hit your head too hard, maybe you should have taken the hard hat after all.
[*] Tower Fall: Climb to the summit, avoiding the crushing obstacles along the way.
[/olist]

📢Your Feedback Matters:

As pioneers of Frontier, your feedback is crucial to shaping the future of our game. Share your thoughts, suggestions, and bug reports with us—we're counting on your valuable input!

🎮 How to Access the TestFire:
[olist]
[*]Head over to the Store Page of Steam.
[*]Click the inviting green button to join the playtest.
[/olist]

Wishing You a Blast!

Best regards,
Treeka 🌳
